game.title: Ayo Olopon
game.tagline: Sow the seeds, capture the pits!
game.howto.1: Each side has 6 pits with 4 seeds in each. On your turn tap one of your pits (or press 1 to 6). Its seeds are sown one by one, counter-clockwise, starting with the next pit.
game.howto.2: If you sow 12 or more seeds, the pit you started from is skipped.
game.howto.3: If your last seed lands in an opponent's pit and makes it 2 or 3 seeds, you capture that pit. You also capture the pits just before it, as long as each one holds 2 or 3.
game.howto.4: If the other side is empty, you must play a pit that gives them seeds. If you cannot, the game ends and the seeds left on the board go to their owners.
game.howto.5: Seeds in your tray are yours. The first to collect 25 of the 48 seeds wins. 24 each is a draw.
game.howto.6: Not sure what to play? Tap Hint. The Rules page lets you change the rules to the way you play Ayo at home.
legend.danger: A pit that can be captured next
rules.title: Rules
rules.variant: Ayo is played a little differently from house to house. The usual rules are on; change anything to the way you play it.
rules.tie: If both sides finish with 24 seeds, the game is a draw. The computer follows the same rules as you.
rules.skip: Skip the starting pit on 12+ seeds
rules.skip.help: On: a sow of 12 or more seeds skips the pit it started from. Off: that pit gets a seed too.
rules.chain.help: On: the pits just before a captured pit are captured too while they hold 2 or 3. Off: only the last pit is captured.
rules.feed: Must give seeds to an empty side
rules.feed.help: On: when the other side has no seeds, you must play a pit that reaches it. Off: any pit may be played.
rules.fast.help: Seeds are sown and the computer thinks about 1.7 times quicker.
rules.capture.help.twoThree: A pit that your last seed brings to 2 or 3 seeds is captured.
rules.capture.help.threeOnly: Only a pit that your last seed brings to exactly 3 seeds is captured.
rules.end.help.owners: When the game ends early, each player keeps the seeds on their own side.
rules.end.help.starver: When the game ends early, the player who could not move loses the seeds left on the board to the other player.
board.label: Ayo board: 12 pits in two rows and a seed tray on each side
play.yourTurn: Your turn. Tap a glowing pit.
play.mustFeed: The other side has no seeds. Play a pit that reaches them.
play.mustFeedTap: That pit cannot reach the other side. Pick a glowing one.
play.hintSay: Try pit {n}. Pits marked with ! can be captured next.
play.end.stuck: No move can give seeds to the other side. The game ends and the seeds are counted.
play.end.empty: One side has no seeds left. The game ends and the seeds are counted.
play.end.cap: This game has gone on too long. The seeds are counted now.
persona.efe.name: Efe
persona.baba-ade.name: Baba Ade
persona.malam-sani.name: Malam Sani
ayo.banter.baba-ade.start: My child, let me teach you a lesson in patience.

ayo.banter.baba-ade.chain.text: Ah, a chain! Even a teacher must learn.

ayo.banter.baba-ade.win: In my school days, I never lost at Ayo.

ayo.banter.baba-ade.lose.text: Ẹ kú iṣẹ́! Well done on your work.

ayo.banter.baba-ade.draw.text: Equal seeds. Teacher and student, side by side.

ayo.banter.baba-ade.idle.text: Count your seeds well, my child. No hurry.

ayo.banter.efe.start.text: Oya, let us play! I will sing while I sow.

ayo.banter.efe.capture.text: Sorry o, I took your seeds!

ayo.banter.efe.captured.text: Ehen! You have a good hand o!

ayo.banter.efe.chain.text: Look at that chain! Ah ah!

ayo.banter.efe.win.text: I won! Ah, I will sing for the two of us.

ayo.banter.efe.lose.text: You win! I will sing for you.

ayo.banter.efe.draw.text: Same seeds! Nobody loses, nobody wins o.

ayo.banter.efe.idle.text: Come on, tap a pit! I am waiting.

ayo.banter.malam-sani.start.text: Sannu, my friend. Let us begin.

ayo.banter.malam-sani.chain.text: One pit leads to the next. Patience pays.

ayo.banter.malam-sani.win.text: Good game. We learn from every game.

ayo.banter.malam-sani.lose: No problem. We learn from every game.

ayo.banter.malam-sani.idle.text: Take your time, my friend. The seeds will wait.
